source: Koala MCP connector tool definitions and user-supplied 62-tool beta inventory
transcription_notice: Local conservative input contracts, NOT a byte-for-byte tools/list capture. Always inspect live definitions. Opaque inputs require a separate live review. Costs are snapshot estimates, not a billing guarantee.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.notes: Check platform credits and writer words separately. Reading a balance does not reserve it.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.notes: Resolve the brand deliberately. Do not copy account results into the public repository.

tools.name: get_brand_profile
tools.notes: Inspect integration and effective post status before generation; presets or project overrides can change them.

tools.name: get_brand_knowledge
tools.notes: Saved business facts are context, not independent verification of every claim. No knowledge-update tool is exposed.

tools.name: list_writer_presets
tools.notes: Named preset settings replace defaults as a snapshot, not a shallow overlay. Use exact discovered names only.

tools.name: list_article_tasks
tools.notes: One status array is preferable to repeated one-status calls. Calendar coverage is separate from published coverage.

tools.name: create_article_in_koala_writer
tools.notes: Creation can upload or publish via brand/project integration. Omit both for standalone output. Never enable allowDuplicate without explicit authorization for another article. Persist articleId before waiting. Prompts cannot enable image pipeline settings.

tools.name: get_article_status
tools.notes: Resume the same article ID. No tight polling loop and no replacement job after a timeout.

tools.name: get_article_content
tools.notes: Polished falls back to original when no edited version exists. Read only account-owned articles; validate identity when no brand filter is used.

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.notes: Bounded recent results are not a complete article inventory. Ambiguous matches require disambiguation, not a guessed ID.

tools.name: edit_article
tools.notes: One platform credit, no writer words. Instructions are self-contained. Previous content is saved and concurrent edits rejected; do not assume a restore or CMS publish tool exists.

tools.name: schedule_articles
tools.notes: Executable NEW-content tasks, not a planning list. Max 10. Future generation consumes words. Live settings at execution may cause publication. Autopilot entitlement is separate.

tools.name: update_scheduled_articles
tools.notes: Max 20, only not-started tasks. writerArgs replaces the entire override object; {} clears overrides. A reschedule changes execution/publication timing; inspect per-task failures.

tools.name: remove_scheduled_articles
tools.notes: Max 50. Cancels future scheduled work; does not delete running/completed jobs, saved articles or CMS posts. Reconcile unmatched IDs.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.notes: Hosted URL can precede completion. This neither inserts images into an article nor publishes a social post. Reference-image rights and privacy need review.

tools.name: get_gsc_search_performance
tools.notes: Measured connected-property data. Explicit inclusive date pairs; equal periods and same filters. GSC country filters use alpha-3. Missing or truncated rows are not zero. compare=true is supported only on aggregate search performance.

tools.name: get_gsc_top_queries
tools.notes: Measured connected-property data. Explicit inclusive date pairs; equal periods and same filters. GSC country filters use alpha-3. Missing or truncated rows are not zero. compare=true is supported only on aggregate search performance.

tools.name: get_gsc_top_pages
tools.notes: Measured connected-property data. Explicit inclusive date pairs; equal periods and same filters. GSC country filters use alpha-3. Missing or truncated rows are not zero. compare=true is supported only on aggregate search performance.

tools.name: get_gsc_query_performance
tools.notes: Measured connected-property data. Explicit inclusive date pairs; equal periods and same filters. GSC country filters use alpha-3. Missing or truncated rows are not zero. compare=true is supported only on aggregate search performance.

tools.name: get_gsc_page_performance
tools.notes: Measured connected-property data. Explicit inclusive date pairs; equal periods and same filters. GSC country filters use alpha-3. Missing or truncated rows are not zero. compare=true is supported only on aggregate search performance.

tools.name: get_gsc_indexing_status
tools.notes: Max 10 URLs belonging to the connected property. A sitemap entry is not indexation evidence.

tools.name: get_ga4_top_pages
tools.notes: Measured connected GA4 data. dateRange/compareRange are not GSC startDate/endDate. Page performance takes a path, not a URL. Sessions and GSC clicks are different measures.

tools.name: get_ga4_traffic_sources
tools.notes: Measured connected GA4 data. dateRange/compareRange are not GSC startDate/endDate. Page performance takes a path, not a URL. Sessions and GSC clicks are different measures.

tools.name: get_ga4_audience_overview
tools.notes: Measured connected GA4 data. dateRange/compareRange are not GSC startDate/endDate. Page performance takes a path, not a URL. Sessions and GSC clicks are different measures.

tools.name: get_ga4_page_performance
tools.notes: Measured connected GA4 data. dateRange/compareRange are not GSC startDate/endDate. Page performance takes a path, not a URL. Sessions and GSC clicks are different measures.

tools.name: request_indexing
tools.notes: Explicit separate submission authorization. Max 20. A successful request is not an indexing guarantee; do not substitute generic Google Indexing API claims.

tools.name: check_keyword_coverage
tools.notes: Max 30. Model judgments from sitemap/ranking evidence; not planned tasks and not proof of absence. Inspect matched URL and intent before replacement.

tools.name: get_keyword_volume
tools.notes: Max 20 per market. Provider estimates. Advertising competition/CPC are not organic difficulty or affiliate earnings.

tools.name: get_related_keywords
tools.notes: Max 5 seeds. Bills per successful unique trimmed seed; reserve all unique seeds conservatively. Related terms are not automatically new content intents.

tools.name: get_keyword_variations
tools.notes: Max 5 seeds. Variations contain the seed; do not confuse variants with distinct intents. Paid per successful unique trimmed seed.

tools.name: get_autocomplete
tools.notes: This exposed input surface has no country/language arguments. Record market as provider-default/unknown rather than invent parameters. Suggestions are not volumes.

tools.name: get_keyword_gap
tools.notes: Ranking gap does not establish a content gap. Check the target site and its calendar.

tools.name: discover_domain_keywords
tools.notes: Ideas related to a niche, not a ranking inventory. Avoid speculative keyword-to-revenue conversion.

tools.name: get_ranking_keywords
tools.notes: Provider-observed rankings are separate from GSC. Exact keywordContains is whole-word; broad is substring.

tools.name: get_competitor_domains
tools.notes: Search competitors may have different business models. Validate relevance before a teardown.

tools.name: get_estimated_top_pages
tools.notes: Estimated organic traffic/value, not measured visits or revenue. Confirm page intent with a fetch.

tools.name: get_traffic_overview
tools.notes: Directional provider estimates, not connected first-party metrics.

tools.name: get_historical_traffic
tools.notes: Higher-cost monthly estimates. Use only when a time-series question changes the decision; align markets and periods.

tools.name: get_domain_authority
tools.notes: Moz Domain Authority, not a Google metric and not the backlink provider rank.

tools.name: get_backlink_summary
tools.notes: Provider totals and referring domains; avoid conflating domains with individual links.

tools.name: get_referring_domains
tools.notes: A domain includes only a sample backlink, not every link. Provider rank is not Moz DA. Broken links are candidates needing current verification.

tools.name: get_backlink_list
tools.notes: Individual link records. First seen is discovery time, not publication time; lost is provider-observed, not independently confirmed.

tools.name: get_anchor_texts
tools.notes: Do not infer a penalty from an anchor-text ratio alone.

tools.name: get_backlink_gap
tools.notes: One competitor per call. Candidates are not endorsements or guaranteed placements; no outreach-sending tool is included.

tools.name: search_google_serp
tools.notes: Use keyword, not query. Locality uses location; there is no country input here. Fetch sources to verify precise claims; snippets are discovery evidence.

tools.name: get_google_trends
tools.notes: Relative 0–100 interest, not monthly volume. Cross-call normalization can differ. Preserve market and search surface.

tools.name: get_pinterest_trends
tools.notes: Pinterest interest is not Google volume. Seasonal future dates are planning signals, not observed future demand.

tools.name: get_sitemap
tools.notes: Default 1,000, up to 50,000 slugs; 90-second/200-child bounds. returnedSlugCount is returned inventory, not site total. No proof of indexation or orphan status.

tools.name: screenshot_page
tools.notes: Visual inspection only. Does not prove full markup or crawler access; mobile overrides desktop dimensions.

tools.name: search_youtube
tools.notes: Search results do not contain the full video. Inspect captions and usage rights separately.

tools.name: get_youtube_captions
tools.notes: Caption text can be automatic and incomplete. Verify exact names and factual claims; captions are not reuse rights.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.notes: Up to 100,000 characters per returned chunk. Continue with returned nextOffset and same contentHash; every chunk costs credits. Changed hash requires restart. Extracted text can omit important markup; not finding a fact does not prove absence.

tools.name: get_page_html
tools.notes: Up to 250,000 characters per returned chunk. Continue with returned nextOffset and same contentHash; every chunk costs credits. Changed hash requires restart. Raw HTML is not JavaScript-rendered.

tools.name: analyze_page
tools.notes: Source-derived analyst answer, not a complete deterministic SEO audit. Analyst sees up to 24,000 extracted characters; verify critical facts against source text/HTML.

tools.name: check_ai_crawler_robots_rules
tools.notes: Declared crawler-specific robots rules, not a network/firewall test or an AI-engine visibility measurement.

tools.name: get_google_ai_overview_presence
tools.notes: Sampled Google AI Overviews only, not ChatGPT/Claude/all AI. This exposed schema has no country/language input; disclose unknown provider market. Absent citation is sample absence.

tools.name: get_ai_search_opportunities
tools.notes: Max 3 seeds. Opportunity hypotheses, not observed all-engine visibility.

tools.name: audit_page_citation_readiness
tools.notes: Heuristic 0–100 readiness score, not an observed citation rate or guarantee. Use a nonempty set of max 3 URLs.

tools.name: compare_google_ai_overview_citations
tools.notes: Up to 3 competitors and 5 queries. Preserve the sampled query set; no market argument exposed. Do not broaden findings to all AI engines.

tools.name: search_brand_mentions
tools.notes: Web search mentions, not AI-chat mentions or an exhaustive count. Inspect source pages before assigning sentiment.

tools.name: amazon_search
tools.notes: Resolve candidate ASINs in the requested marketplace. No guarantee of current price, stock or testing.

tools.name: amazon_product_details
tools.notes: Connector exposed an unconstrained argument object. Discover and inspect the live tool before invocation; no ASIN argument name is asserted by this pack. Returned price may be absent; attribute reviewer observations.
